Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2. Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: See standard FIX explanation. The sequence number, on the initial logon for each trading day, must be set to 1.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmissions, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: The value used must be recognized and agreed to by Nasdaq Canada. Case sensitive, maximum of 15 characters.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: This can be used to indicate a specific Nasdaq Canada account or client. Nasdaq Canada ignores this tag.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Indicates the time the message was sent by the client.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Identifies Nasdaq Canada as the receiving firm.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Printed as TargetSubid in the New Order Single and Cross tables (not in the header table). Indicates how the order should be routed: CHIX, CX2, CXD, or a Smart Order Router (SOR) strategy value provided by Nasdaq Canada Operations following certification. A valid value is required in either TargetSubID (57) or ExDestination (100).

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2. Will be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Will be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Will be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: See standard FIX explanation.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmissions, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: The value originally supplied to Nasdaq Canada in the TargetCompID field in the logon message from the Client.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Indicates the time the message was sent by Nasdaq Canada.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: The value originally supplied to Nasdaq Canada in the SenderCompID field in the logon message from the Client.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: The value originally supplied to Nasdaq Canada in the SenderSubID field in related application messages from the Client, if specified.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always unencrypted, always last field in message.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Nasdaq Canada sends a message at least once in the heartbeat interval and must receive one from the client at least once in the heartbeat interval defined in the logon.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Message.Name: Test Request
Message.Description: Handled by Nasdaq Canada as a session level message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Message.Name: Resend Request
Message.Description: Nasdaq Canada transmits any unsent execution reports on receipt of a Resend Request from the client for the missing sequence numbers.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Sent by Nasdaq Canada with the sequence number of the rejected message and an explanation of the error in the text field whenever possible. A message received with a sequence number less than expected and without PossDupFlag is discarded and rejected.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message. Reject messages sent by Nasdaq Canada include the sequence number of the rejected message. Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Explanation of the nature of the error, whenever possible.

Message.Name: Sequence Reset
Message.Description: Handled by Nasdaq Canada as a session level message.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Nasdaq Canada logs out client sessions before the start of the nightly maintenance window. The negative response to a Logon request is a Logout.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: First message expected from the client. Nasdaq Canada validates the SenderCompID, performs recovery and replies with a Logon; no messages should be sent until the reply is received.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Nasdaq Canada does not support encryption of FIX messages. Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval; must be greater than zero. Standard FIX 4.2 field; not reprinted in the application notes.

Message.Name: New Order Single
Message.Description: New order. A Cross order is a New Order Single with Side (54) = 8 (Cross) or 9 (Cross Short); rows printed in both the New Order Single and the Cross tables are common, the rows printed only in the Cross table are the Cross and Cross Short cases and the rows printed only in the New Order Single table are the Order (default) case.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: New Order Single: Must be unique for each order throughout the trading day, across all stocks and sides from the same FIX Session ID. A FIX server will not necessarily verify the uniqueness of ClOrdID. Maximum of 32 characters. Cross: Must be unique for each order throughout the trading day, across all stocks and sides from the same FIX Session ID.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: New Order Single: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada (some values may be combined and each must be separated by a space). Any other value will be ignored. DAO orders to CXD will be accepted, but DAO will be ignored. Cross: f = DAO.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: New Order Single: Instructions for order handling on Nasdaq Canada's trading system. All other values will be modified to 1. Tag 18=f will override any value in tag 21 and the order treated as DAO. Cross: Instructions for order handling on Nasdaq Canada's trading system. Value supported for Crosses: 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention. All other values will be modified to 1.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Quantity of order.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: New Order Single: Order type. Any other values will cause the order to be rejected. Cross: Value supported by Nasdaq Canada for Crosses: 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New Order Single: Required for limit orders. If included in a Market order, the order will be rejected. Cross: Required for limit orders.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: New Order Single: Side of order. Any other values will cause the order to be rejected. Cross: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada for Crosses: 8 = Cross, 9 = Cross Short.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Local/exchange symbol only.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: New Order Single: Absence of this field indicates a day order. Day orders are in effect until the client cancels the order, or until the Nasdaq Canada trading system is shut down for nightly maintenance. Any other values will cause the order to be rejected. Cross: Absence of this field indicates a day order. Value supported for Crosses: 0 = Day.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this order request was initiated by client.

Field.Name: ExDestination
Field.Description: Indicates how the order should be routed: CHIX, CX2, CXD, or a Smart Order Router (SOR) strategy value provided by Nasdaq Canada Operations following certification. A valid value is required in either TargetSubID (57) or ExDestination (100).

Field.Name: UMIRUserID
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting, the trading system's user ID for the trader.

Field.Name: BasketTrade
Field.Description: Identification for order as part of a basket trade: N = No (Default), or 1*5Digit = Basket Number.

Field.Name: ProgramTrade
Field.Description: An order that is part of a basket trade comprised of Index securities to offset a futures or options position.

Field.Name: Anonymous
Field.Description: New Order Single: Whether the TSX Broker Number should be hidden on the order book and execution. Cross: Whether the execution should hide the TSX Broker Number.

Field.Name: Bypass
Field.Description: New Order Single: Order marker that indicates the order should only trade with displayed volumes, i.e. ignore any hidden quantities. These orders are treated as IOC. Y or N; default is N. (Not supported on CXD) Cross: Regulatory marker indicating order is placed in conjunction with bypass orders. Y or N; default is N.

Field.Name: ShortMarkingExempt
Field.Description: New Order Single: Identifies an order as Short Marking Exempt (SME). Not valid on short sell orders. Cross: Identifies an order as Short Marking Exempt (SME). Not valid on short sell orders. Value of 2 or 3 not valid on cross short orders.

Field.Name: POComment
Field.Description: A free-form, pass-through tag provided for use by Participants. Maximum of 32 characters.

Field.Name: SettlType
Field.Description: Settlement terms of the order.

Field.Name: SettlDate
Field.Description: Specific date of trade settlement in YYYYMMDD format. Required if the value of SettlType (63) is 6.

Field.Name: CHIXBuyAccountType
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting. If unspecified, Default (CL) is applied. Buy side of the Cross.

Field.Name: CHIXSellAccountType
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting. If unspecified, Default (CL) is applied. Sell side of the Cross.

Field.Name: FacilitationSide

Field.Name: MaxFloor

Field.Name: ExpireTime

Field.Name: PegDifference

The NoTradeFeat of the incoming order will take precedence.

Field.Name: NoTradeKey
Field.Description: This participant-generated key prevents the order from trading against orders with the same key value. 6*AlphaNumeric, no default.

Field.Name: SeekPriceImprovement

Field.Name: DisplayRange

Field.Name: MaxRate
Field.Description: Required maximum rate for CXD PureStream Custom Reference Rate Range (847=1003) orders. Specified in percent as integer (e.g. 5% should be sent as 27005=5) (Min 1%, Max 500%). Must be greater than or equal to MinRate (27005).

Field.Description: Unique ID of cancel request assigned by the client. Maximum of 32 characters.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required by the FIX protocol, ignored by Nasdaq Canada. All cancel requests are for full remaining quantity.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of original order to be cancelled as assigned by client. Maximum of 32 characters.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this order request was initiated by client.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of replacement order as assigned by the client. Maximum of 32 characters.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: For a replacement order, this field must be populated anew (i.e. original order values will not be brought forward to replacement order unless redefined within this message).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Printed as OrdQty. The quantity in the Cancel/Replace message is the total order quantity, as defined by the FIX protocol and total order quantity semantics.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: New Order Type for the request. Values supported: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit, P = Pegged (requires ExecInst of M, R, P or x).

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of order to be replaced as assigned by client. Maximum of 32 characters.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required for Limit orders.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Absence indicates a Day order.

Field.Description: Time this order request was initiated by client.

Message.Name: Market Participant Command
Message.Description: Sent by GEF Members to set the Guaranteed Execution Facility commitment for a designated security.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Local/exchange symbol.

Field.Name: ExDestination
Field.Description: CX2 (Default).

Field.Name: UMIRUserID
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting, the trading system's user ID for the trader.

Field.Name: PartCommandID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned by the GEF Member to the message. Maximum of 32 characters.

Field.Name: GEFCommitVolume
Field.Description: The size (shares) of the GEF Member's commitment for auto-executions. Must be at least the GMV for the Designated Security.

Message.Name: Execution Report
Message.Description: One Execution Report carrying the union of the New Order Single Response (also used as the Replace Response), Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement and Trade Report tables. A row is Required only when all four tables print it as Y; each description names the tables that print the row when it is not in all four.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Trade Report: Identifies the trading account. Maximum of 15 characters. Printed in New Order Single Response, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement: The average price of all shares traded. Defaulted to 0 for order acknowledgements. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: The average price of all shares traded. Trade Report: Average price of shares traded.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement: Nasdaq Canada will always populate this field with the value assigned by client in the New Order Single message. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: Nasdaq Canada will always populate this field with the value assigned by client in the Order Cancel Request message. Trade Report: Nasdaq Canada will always populate this field with the original value assigned by client in the New Order Single message. Required (Y) in New Order Single Response.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement: The total shares traded against the original order quantity. Defaulted to 0 for order acknowledgements. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: The total shares traded against the original order quantity. Trade Report: Total shares traded against the original order quantity.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement: Currency associated with symbol in Symbol (55) field. Trade Report: Currency in which the security is traded.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement: A unique identifier of execution message as assigned by Nasdaq Canada. Trade Report: A unique identifier of execution message as assigned by NASDAQ. It is the client's responsibility to detect and appropriately process possible duplicate ExecIDs, regardless of whether the PossResend flag has been set on the message or not.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada (some values may be combined and each must be separated by a space). Any other value will be ignored. DAO orders to CXD will be accepted, but DAO will be ignored. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Trade Report: Used in a trade correct or cancel message (i.e. ExecTransType = 1 or 2) to refer to the previous Execution Report to which the current message applies. Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment: 0 = New. Restatement: 1 = Cancelled, 3 = Status. Trade Report: 0 = New to indicate a trade report, 1 = Cancel to indicate a trade cancel, 2 = Correct to indicate a trade revision.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada: 1, 5, 6. Required (Y) in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement only.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID (48) value. (Drop copy only)

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: Defaulted to 0 for order acknowledgements. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: Defaulted to 0 for order cancel acknowledgements. Price at which the match would have occurred if not prevented when cancelled/replaced due to no-self trade. Trade Report: Price of shares bought or sold on this fill. Required (Y) in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: Defaulted to 0 for order acknowledgements. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: Defaulted to 0 for order cancel acknowledgements. The quantity of shares that would have matched if not prevented when cancelled/replaced due to no-self trade. Trade Report: Quantity of shares bought or sold on this fill. Required (Y) in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Nasdaq Canada order reference number.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Quantity of original order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: 0 = New, 5 = Replaced, 8 = Rejected. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: 4 = Cancelled. Restatement: 4 = Cancelled, O = Stream On, X = Stream Off. Trade Report: 1 = Partially filled, 2 = Filled, 4 = Cancelled.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada: 1, 2, 5, B, P.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Order Cancel Acknowledgment: Unique ID of original order to be cancelled as assigned by client. Required (Y) in Order Cancel Acknowledgment. Printed in Order Cancel Acknowledgment only.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Limit Price. Required for limit orders only. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: Limit Price.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource (22) type. (Drop copy only)

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell short. Trade Report: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell Short.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement: Local/exchange symbol. Trade Report: Returns the Local/exchange symbol of the security traded.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Will be returned if supplied in original New Order Single message.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Trade Report: Time and date of execution (expressed as GMT). Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: SettlType
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Trade Report: Settlement terms of the order. Printed in New Order Single Response, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: SettlDate
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: Specific date of trade settlement in YYYYMMDD format. Returned if the value of SettlType (63) is 6. Trade Report: Specific date of trade settlement in YYYYMMDD format. Required if the value of SettlType (63) is 6. Printed in New Order Single Response, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Trade Report: Date of trade in YYYYMMDD format. Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Execution broker. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: Used with OrdStatus = 8 (Rejected) if reason is definable. Printed in New Order Single Response only.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: 0 = New, 5 = Replaced, 8 = Rejected. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: 4 = Cancelled. Restatement: D = Restated. Trade Report: 1 = Partially filled, 2 = Filled, 4 = Cancelled.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Amount of shares open for further execution.

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: When present, NASDAQ order number as reported in the market data feed (CHIXMD) otherwise use tag 37. Trade Report: When present, Nasdaq Canada order number as reported in the market data feed (CHIXMD) otherwise use tag 37. Printed in New Order Single Response, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Trade Report: Listing market of security. Required (Y) in Trade Report. Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: TargetStrategy
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Required for CXD PureStream orders. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Broker / Dealer needs to report, as specified by the customer. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: RoutingArrangementIndicator
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Routing arrangement indicator. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: UMIRAccountType
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting. If unspecified, Default (CL) is applied. Required (Y) in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: UMIRUserID
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting, the trading system's user ID for the trader.

Field.Name: Jitney
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: To mark an order as being executed on behalf of another broker: TSX Broker Number, 3 digit numeric. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: GEFEligible
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: Indicator to identify if an order is eligible for the Guaranteed Execution Facility (GEF). Printed in New Order Single Response only.

Field.Name: Anonymous
Field.Description: Whether the TSX Broker Number should be hidden on the order book and execution.

Field.Name: UMIRRegulationID
Field.Description: Identification marker for UMIR-specific designations to orders and trades.

Field.Name: BrokerNumber
Field.Description: TSX Broker Number, 3 digit numeric. (Drop copy only)

Field.Name: PrincipalTrade
Field.Description: Trade Report: A principal transaction between a dealer and a dealer's customer's account. Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: WashTrade
Field.Description: Trade Report: A trade that has occurred between proprietary accounts of the same member firm. Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: Bypass
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report: Will be returned if supplied in original New Order Single message. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: TSXNCIB
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report: Will be returned if supplied in original New Order Single message. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: ShortMarkingExempt
Field.Description: Will be returned if supplied in original New Order Single message.

Field.Name: SeekPriceImprovement
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report: Trade with price improving hidden orders. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: ExecuteMatch
Field.Description: Trade Report: Trade matched and suppressed due to no self-trade. Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: POComment
Field.Description: A free-form, pass-through tag provided for use by Participants. Maximum of 32 characters.

Field.Name: CustomerAccount
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Account number for clients not eligible to obtain an LEI. 20 Alphanumeric. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: AlgorithmID
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Unique identifier for the end-client (orders automatically generated on a predetermined basis). 20 Alphanumeric. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: CustomerLEI
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: LEI for clients eligible to obtain an LEI including LEI of the foreign dealer equivalent (Encryption Required). 52 Alphanumeric. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: BrokerLEI
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report: Non-PO IIROC Dealer Member (Correspondent Broker). 20 Alphanumeric. Printed in New Order Single Response, Restatement, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: RepriceReason
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: Populated with a reason code if the order is repriced. Printed in New Order Single Response only.

Field.Name: NBBOSetter
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: The Order is an NBBO Setter. Printed in New Order Single Response only.

Field.Name: BrokerPref
Field.Description: Trade Report: Trade matched due to broker preferencing. Printed in Trade Report only.

Field.Name: OrigSendercompID
Field.Description: SenderCompID of the original order entry session. (Drop copy only)

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Order Cancel Acknowledgment: Liquidity indicator if the match would have occurred if not prevented when cancelled/replaced due to no-self trade. Trade Report: Liquidity indicator. Printed in Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Trade Report only.

Field.Name: ConditionalOrder
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment: CXD only. Restatement: R = Conditional order firm-up request. CXD PureStream only. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement only.

Field.Name: AllowConditional
Field.Description: CXD PureStream SOK orders only.

Field.Name: FirmUpID
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment: The FirmUpID received in a Conditional match. Restatement: Unique firm up ID for a Conditional match. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement only.

Field.Name: CXDConnect
Field.Description: New Order Single Response, Restatement: CXD orders only. Order Cancel Acknowledgment: CXD orders only. (Req column blank in the PDF) Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement only.

Field.Name: PureStreamConnect
Field.Description: New Order Single Response: CXD Conditional orders only. (Req column blank in the PDF) Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement: CXD Conditional orders only. Printed in New Order Single Response, Order Cancel Acknowledgment, Restatement only.

Field.Name: MinRate
Field.Description: Minimum rate for CXD PureStream Custom Reference Rate Range (847=1003) and LS (847=1004) orders. Specified in percent as integer (e.g. 5% should be sent as 27005=5). Default 1% if not specified (Min 1%, Max 32,767%). Must be less than or equal to MaxRate (27006).

Field.Name: MaxRate
Field.Description: Required maximum rate for CXD PureStream Custom Reference Rate Range (847=1003) orders. Specified in percent as integer (e.g. 5% should be sent as 27005=5) (Min 1%, Max 500%). Must be greater than or equal to MinRate (27005).

Field.Name: CumRate
Field.Description: Restatement: The current cumulative streaming rate the order is achieving (includes multiple streams, if applicable). CXD PureStream Stream On messages only. Trade Report: The current cumulative streaming rate the order is achieving (includes multiple streams, if applicable). CXD PureStream only. Printed in Restatement, Trade Report only.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Reject
Message.Description: Order Cancel and Cancel/Replace Reject, sent in response to an order cancel or cancel/replace request that is rejected.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Nasdaq Canada will always populate this field with the value assigned by client in the Order Cancel or Cancel/Replace message. If the Cancel/Replace request is rejected, this is the ClOrdID of the replacement order.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Nasdaq Canada order reference number.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: OrdStatus value after this cancel reject is applied.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Nasdaq Canada will always populate this field with the value assigned by client in the most recently accepted New Order Single or Order Cancel/Replace message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: The reason for the cancel reject.

Field.Name: ListID
Field.Description: Required for rejects against orders which were submitted as part of a list.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Type of request to which this is a response.

Message.Name: Market Participant Command Response
Message.Description: Response to a Market Participant Command request.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Values supported by Nasdaq Canada: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Local/exchange symbol.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: The reason for the Market Participant Command reject.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: 0 = New, 8 = Rejected. If the Market Participant Command message is rejected, the GEF Member's commitment remains at the value set prior to the Market Participant Command message.

Field.Name: UMIRUserID
Field.Description: Required for Canadian regulatory reporting, the trading system's user ID for the trader.

Field.Name: PartCommandID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned by the GEF Member to the message.

Field.Name: GEFCommitVolume
Field.Description: The size (shares) of the GEF Member's commitment for auto-executions.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: TSX Broker Number on the opposite side of trade. Will not be populated if contra order is anonymous.
